race_context: How the seat is elected: the ballot names a commissioner district, and the candidate must live in it, but outside Lake and St. Joseph counties every voter in the county can vote in each commissioner race {in_guide}{ic_36_2_2_5}.

Finding the current officeholder and record: county websites list commissioners' responsibilities and meeting information, and board agendas and minutes show recent votes on contracts, claims, roads and rezoning requests {boone_comm}{ibj_datacenters}.
Comparing candidates: the Indiana Election Division publishes the official 2026 candidate list, and county clerks and election boards post sample ballots for each county {in_list}{in_guide}.
Marion County voters do not see a commissioner race: the elected assessor, auditor and treasurer serve as Marion County's commissioners {indy_enc_comm}.
